scope: Static UI design and cut assets only
commonPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one STATIC high-fidelity UI design image for xdnote, a modern cross-platform local Markdown reader/editor.
The supplied reference is VISUAL STYLE REFERENCE, not a screenshot to copy verbatim. Preserve its warm-white/pale-gray surfaces, graphite controls, refined Chinese typography, thin outline icons, 6px control corners, hairline neutral dividers and spacious uncluttered desktop proportions. Product name is now EXACTLY "xdnote", not "Markdown". Use a tiny outlined folded-document icon beside the product label.
LIGHT tokens: surface #FFFFFF, navigation #F4F5F7, text #1F2937, secondary #667085, accent #374151 with white text, soft selection #EBECEE. DARK tokens when requested: background #1B1F25, surface #22272F, text #E6EAF0, secondary #AAB4C0, accent #B3BDCC with #171A21 text. Semantic green saved checks, amber warnings and muted red errors are independent of accent. Never use teal as the app accent.
Crisp straight-on orthographic desktop UI, complete product bounds, landscape 3:2 canvas at very high resolution. A slim quiet outer margin; no devices, perspective, photographic props, marketing slogans, illustrations unrelated to reading, fake metrics, account/AI/cloud panes, watermarks or long outside annotations. Simplified Chinese must be correct and clearly readable, with comfortable product-sized text and consistent alignment.
Use standard monochrome Windows window controls except in the explicit cross-platform board. Do not show a running implementation, code frameworks, licenses/versions not supplied, or testing results. All controls and feedback should look like practical shipping product design.
For multi-panel boards, all panels are equally polished. Separate panels with a generous neutral gutter, no overlaps. Each panel gets only a short Chinese state label OUTSIDE its product surface. Keep enough size for actual controls and their text. No arrows or explanatory prose inside the product.
Shared sample document: filename "写作，从这里开始.md"; parent "文档 / 个人笔记"; title "写作，从这里开始"; paragraph "把想法写下来，让思考慢慢清晰。"; quote "少一点干扰，多一点专注。"; heading "一个安静的写作空间"; task list "记录一个新的想法", "整理本周的阅读笔记", "留一点时间，自由写作". Source and preview content must correspond when both shown.

layoutInstructions.single: Composition: one complete image at large readable size. If the requested content is a component specimen, use the entire canvas for that specimen.
layoutInstructions.two: Composition: exactly TWO equally sized product panels, LEFT and RIGHT, with a clear vertical gutter and short state labels above. Each panel is fully in frame. Aim for two tall desktop windows, not overlapping screenshots.
layoutInstructions.four: Composition: exactly FOUR equally sized product panels in a strict 2 by 2 grid. All four complete surfaces in frame, generous gutters, labels above each. Use compact dialogs or bounded fragments; do not shrink an entire desktop into each cell.
layoutInstructions.six: Composition: exactly SIX equally sized component/state panels in a strict 2 columns by 3 rows grid. Clear gutters, no overlaps, short labels.
layoutInstructions.top-wide-two: Composition: THREE panels. One wide comparison product window spans the TOP 55% of the canvas. Two compact product panels sit BOTTOM LEFT and BOTTOM RIGHT with a generous gutter. All bounds visible.

boards.title: 设置检索与保存反馈
boards.promptAddendum: Critical consistency: keyboard focus rings and selected menu/cell highlights use the CURRENT GRAPHITE ACCENT with pale gray fill, never bright blue focus or blue selection rails on a graphite screen. Blue is allowed only as code syntax or an explicitly named different accent swatch.

frames.title: 设置搜索
frames.description: Compact settings shell with search query 保存, result list 自动保存 under 通用 and 关闭前保护 under 通用. Results show category breadcrumbs and clear highlighted matching characters. No new settings categories.

frames.title: 设置搜索无结果
frames.description: Same settings shell, query 同步, heading 没有找到相关设置, helper 试试其他关键词。, action 清除搜索. Preserve the six established categories in sidebar.

frames.title: 设置保存失败
frames.description: Same 外观与配色 page with nonblocking muted red top banner 未能保存设置，本次更改已撤回。 actions 重试 and 关闭提示. Graphite remains selected; do not show a success footer simultaneously. Below preview still usable.

frames.title: 关闭保护固定策略
frames.description: A compact 通用 settings section titled 关闭保护. Static enabled lock row 始终提醒未保存的修改 with helper 关闭或退出前，需先保存或明确放弃修改。. NO toggle to disable this policy. Neutral text value 已启用 and lock icon. Show auto-save separately OFF and delay disabled.

boards.title: 正文交互与资源边界
boards.promptAddendum: Critical consistency: keyboard focus rings and selected menu/cell highlights use the CURRENT GRAPHITE ACCENT with pale gray fill, never bright blue focus or blue selection rails on a graphite screen. Blue is allowed only as code syntax or an explicitly named different accent swatch.

frames.title: 选区与中文输入
frames.description: Source editor fragment with real Chinese text. One sentence selected pale graphite with readable foreground; caret has composition underline on 输入中的文字. A small generic IME candidate box near caret labelled 1 文字  2 文档  3 文本, outside document flow. No fabricated OS brand. Formatting toolbar and undo remain visible.

frames.title: 本地与网络图片
frames.description: Reading fragment titled 图片 with two clean image placeholders. First 本地图片未找到, alt text 结构示意图, actions 重新定位 and 复制路径. Second 网络图片尚未加载, origin images.example.com, action 仅本次加载. Clearly separate local missing vs remote blocked. No actual remote photograph.

frames.title: 长代码与宽表格
frames.description: Reading fragment with a wide fenced-code panel and 5-column document table. Each has its own visible horizontal scrollbar; outer document remains vertically scrollable. Code has language label and copy icon. Use sensible sample 项目/负责人/状态/备注/更新时间, not application feature claims.

frames.title: 没有标题的大纲
frames.description: Full reading pane with slim outline rail 大纲 showing 本文暂无标题 and helper 添加标题后将在这里显示。. Document body remains visible and readable. Do not put giant empty illustration over the actual paragraph.

boards.title: 导出过程与结果
boards.promptAddendum: Critical consistency: keyboard focus rings and selected menu/cell highlights use the CURRENT GRAPHITE ACCENT with pale gray fill, never bright blue focus or blue selection rails on a graphite screen. Blue is allowed only as code syntax or an explicitly named different accent swatch.

frames.title: 正在导出
frames.description: Compact export surface 正在导出 PDF with filename 写作笔记.pdf and indeterminate spinner/bar, action 取消导出. No numeric percentage. Preview settings temporarily disabled while active.

frames.title: 导出完成
frames.description: Compact success panel 已导出文档, local destination 文档/导出/写作笔记.pdf. Actions 在文件夹中显示 and 完成. This is a design of future result state, no actual runtime claim.

frames.title: 导出失败
frames.description: Compact error panel 未能导出文档, reason 目标位置没有写入权限。. Helper 原 Markdown 文件未修改。. Actions 选择其他位置, 重试, 取消. Do not show save or export success.

frames.title: 已取消导出
frames.description: Compact export pane returned to settings with neutral inline note 导出已取消，原文档保持不变。. Primary 导出 PDF enabled, footer 取消. No alarming confirmation for cancellation before output committed.

boards.title: 外部文件变化边界
boards.promptAddendum: Critical consistency: keyboard focus rings and selected menu/cell highlights use the CURRENT GRAPHITE ACCENT with pale gray fill, never bright blue focus or blue selection rails on a graphite screen. Blue is allowed only as code syntax or an explicitly named different accent swatch.

frames.title: 文件被删除且有编辑
frames.description: Owner dialog 原文件已被删除. Helper 当前未保存内容仍保留，不会自动重建原路径。. Filename 写作笔记.md. Buttons 继续编辑 and 另存为. No default recreate or lost-buffer claim.

frames.title: 文件位置变化
frames.description: Nonblocking reader banner 文件位置已变化 with old location 文档/旧目录/笔记.md and current 文档/新目录/笔记.md, action 查看位置. Reading position preserved visually. Do not auto-open a second document.

frames.title: 文件暂时被占用
frames.description: Shared save error dialog 暂时无法保存此文件. Reason 文件正被其他程序占用，请稍后重试。. Helper 你的修改仍保留在编辑器中。. Actions 继续编辑, 另存为, 重试.

frames.title: 重新打开编码前确认
frames.description: Owner dialog 更换编码并重新打开？ helper 当前未保存的编辑需要先处理。. Filename and current UTF-8. Buttons 取消, 另存为, 保存后继续. No silent buffer replacement or lossy conversion.

notes: P1 and compatibility studies are design coverage, not additions to the first release commitment.
Generation prompts and provenance remain in receipts; only the current board image is retained at a stable path.
The approved brand mark was applied locally to the current raster boards; placement rectangles describe image pixels, not component geometry.
Empty untouched buffers have no dirty dot; close protection is a fixed policy; reading task boxes do not modify Markdown.
Raster glyphs, code syntax and small icons are illustrative. Use product copy and exact editable assets rather than tracing those pixels.
